lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 high-contrast vertical stripes are visible across the lateral torso; spacing is widest at the mid-section and becomes more compressed toward the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Bifurcation identified on the second anterior-most stripe near the dorsal ridge; a secondary Y-split is visible on the fourth stripe from the shoulder in the upper third of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: A single abbreviated dashed line segment is located between the third and fourth primary stripes at the ventral-midline level.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5-6 distinct high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior flank and the upper region of the hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-haunch align horizontally to form a brief semi-connected geometric segment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a backward and upward vector from the skull base, transitioning into a lyrate curvature with the tips oriented medially.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 1.8 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping is visible on the distal ends, comprising approximately 10-15% of the total vertical horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron between the eyes; three white spots on the lower cheek/mandible area; white fringe/mane extending from the throat to the chest; white transverse bands ('stockings') on the lower limbs above the hooves.
